convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for ColorSchaffRVITrendCycle indicator and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all trade execution, position sizing, and money management logic.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator validity

other_exits: Long closes when ColorSchaffRVITrendCycle buffer1[1]<2 (bearish color change)
Short closes when ColorSchaffRVITrendCycle buffer1[1]>5 (bullish color change)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot size; FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=fraction of equity/balance. MM parameter meaning changes based on MMMode selection. All logic delegated to TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses color index values from buffer 1 of ColorSchaffRVITrendCycle: value>5=bullish (trend up), value<2=bearish (trend down). Buy opens when buffer1[1]>5 AND buffer1[0]<6 (color transition confirmation). Sell opens when buffer1[1]<2 AND buffer1[0]>1. Signal time is set to last bar date + timeframe period seconds, used by TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trade timing. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose boolean inputs gate which trade directions and close actions are allowed. Recount flag triggers recalculation on first tick or after CopyBuffer failure. Position check and margin check are performed inside TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) - exact logic not visible in EA source.
python_conversion_notes: 1. ColorSchaffRVITrendCycle is a custom indicator - must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python. The Schaff RVI Trend Cycle combines RVI oscillator with cycle analysis. 2. TradeAlgorithms.mqh contains all position sizing (5 MarginMode variants), position opening/closing, deviation handling, and global variable management - must be reimplemented. 3. The color buffer (buffer index 1) returns integer-like color index values: >5=bullish, <2=bearish, 2-5=neutral. This is the core signal mechanism. 4. SL/TP are in points (1000/2000) - no digit adjustment visible in code, but verify whether TradeAlgorithms.mqh applies adjustment internally. 5. Signal time (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) passed to trade functions may be used for order expiry or pending order logic inside the library. 6. CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles new bar detection with optional SignalBar=0 allowing intrabar signals.
